name: Suzumiya Haruhi no Gyakuten 3
source:
The game is split up into five cases. The game has two gameplay modes, investigation sequences where the player controls Kyon and must navigate collecting clues and information, and trial scenes where the player controls Haruhi.

Like the previous games, Haruhi, Emiri, Ms. Mori, return to reprise their respective roles of defense attorney, prosecutor, and judge, the game introduces yet another foe, Mr. Arakawa, who in this game parodies Godot from the Ace Attorney series, complete with visor and coffee addiction.

Aside from Mr. Arakawa, the game introduces three more characters exclusive to this game, those being Taniguchi, the Vocaloid Hatsune Miku, and Asakura. The overarching story is about attempts on several sudent's lives, and the remergance of Ryoko Asakura.

[From [url=https://haruhi.fandom.com/wiki/Suzumiya_Haruhi_no_Gyakuten_3]Haruhi Wiki[/url]]
translation:
游戏分为五种情况。游戏有两种游戏模式，玩家控制阿虚并必须导航收集线索和信息的调查序列，以及玩家控制春日的审判场景。

与前作一样，春日、惠美里、森女士回归，继续扮演各自的辩护律师、检察官和法官角色，游戏中引入了另一个敌人荒川先生，他在游戏中模仿《逆转裁判》系列中的戈多，戴着面罩和咖啡瘾。

除了荒川先生之外，游戏还引入了另外三位游戏独有的角色，分别是谷口、VOCALOID初音未来和朝仓。故事的主线是关于几名学生的生命尝试以及朝仓凉子的回归。

[来自[url=https://haruhi.fandom.com/wiki/Suzumiya_Haruhi_no_Gyakuten_3]Haruhi Wiki[/url]]
